why: A (universes at 0) is the nine listed theorems: full_iff, faithful_iff, essSurj_iff (for arbitrary groupoids), the consequences IsEquivalence.essSurj/exists_iso/exists_mor_eq/mor_injective, and the witnesses IsEquivalence.id, isEquivalence_pairToPoint. B says the project's IsEquivalence (and EP.equivalences) is the blind IsEquivB: full and faithful via structure maps, a homeomorphism e of the blind Quot orbit spaces with e|x| = |F x|, and a local sc-diffeomorphism on objects. A ⇒ B uses A's full_iff/faithful_iff for (1); (2) holds because the project's orbit space Quotient X.orbitSetoid with Mathlib's quotient topology is definitionally the blind Quot (IsoRelB X), and e is then orbitMap (glue orbitHomeoB_iff); (3) is definitional. B ⇒ A gets the six equivalence conjuncts through B (IsEquivB proved for id and pairToPoint, consequences read off IsEquivB); full_iff/faithful_iff/essSurj_iff are about arbitrary groupoids, not consequences of B, and are re-proved outright (copies). The definitions agree exactly.
